object: Three-point form-factor remainder at four loops; independent finite double-collinear holdout for the four-point form factor
indices: 1-based, exactly the first six DC boundary basis entries
normalization: Same loop normalization as the independently registered three-point R2 and R3; both exact comparisons have factor1.
construction: Cyclic images of the published R4symbCoprod[u], appended to u,v,w, and their negatives appended to 1-u,1-v,1-w. This is uniquely fixed by D3 symmetry and R^u=-R^(1-u).
discovery_use: Reserved finite boundary holdout only; not an equation, RHS or fitted input to the four-point weight-eight discovery.
